description: Create a new API key for this workspace. The plaintext token is returned EXACTLY ONCE in the response — copy it to your CI secrets or local env immediately. Requires Pro tier or above. Requires owner role.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry timestamp. Omit for a non-expiring key (you can always revoke it manually).

name.description: Human-readable label for the key, e.g. "GitHub Actions production" — you'll need this later to identify which key to rotate or revoke.

name: edgegate_create_api_key
